subject: Post-call: infra isolation options, SOC2 & vendor RFI initiation
messages:
From: Julie Park <julie.park@novapulse.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: James Taylor <james.taylor@novapulse.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2029 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: isolation/airgap options from today's call

Diego / Karthik — thanks for the call earlier. Quick recap from our side and a few asks so we can accelerate procurement: 

- Priority: Novapulse needs a private deployment option that can meet HIPAA obligations for PHI and allow regional data residency (US-East).
- Questions from our security team: current SOC 2 status (Type II or in progress?), encryption at rest key ownership options (BYOK/KMS/HSM), and whether Redwood supports fully air-gapped on-prem installs.
- We also asked about network isolation patterns (VPC-only, VPC+private peering, separate subnet + NAT), and whether the runtime supports isolation of KV cache and model artifacts.

Can you share: 
1) SOC 2 report or status and expected audit date if in flight;
2) a short RFI/vetting template we can give to our InfoSec;
3) a simple deployment sketch showing VPC + internet-blocked airgap option (high-level is fine).

We want to kick off the vendor questionnaire ASAP and schedule a technical deep-dive with your infra team next week. James — we'll need to coordinate calendars.

Thanks,
Julie Park
Director, IT Security
Novapulse Health

---
(Attachment: call-notes-20290521.txt)
From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: Julie Park <julie.park@novapulse.com>, James Taylor <james.taylor@novapulse.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 21 May 2029 17:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: isolation/airgap options from today's call

Julie / James — great to meet you both. Appreciate the clear list; below is a compact recap and immediate next steps.

Recap / answers at a high level:
- SOC 2: Redwood currently holds SOC 2 Type II for our hosted control plane. Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) can be covered under a SOC 2 carve-out model; our SOC 2 Type II report is attached for baseline controls. If you require Redwood-managed controls on private infra, we can provide an evidence pack and an adapted attestation scope.
- PHI/HIPAA: We support HIPAA workflows in Private deployments. For on-prem or air-gapped installs, responsibility for physical and network controls is shared; we provide the checklist and configuration guidance to meet HIPAA administrative and technical safeguards.
- Key management: BYOK via customer KMS is supported in Dedicated and Private modes; HSM integrations available for on-prem installers.
- Isolation patterns: we commonly deliver three patterns — VPC with private peering, VPC with transit gateway and restricted egress, and physically air-gapped VM clusters for on-prem. KV cache can be namespace-isolated per-tenant; model artifacts can be stored in customer-managed object stores to meet residency needs.

Attachments I'm sending now:
- redwood-private-deploy-checklist.pdf (high-level responsibilities + config items)
- initial-network-sketch-v0.pptx (simple VPC / airgap sketches)
- vendor-rfi-template.xlsx (our starting RFI you can adapt)

Proposed next steps:
1) We push the RFI template to you now — please route it to your InfoSec.
2) Technical deep-dive (30–45m) w/ our infra architects. We have availability Thu AM (05/23) or Fri PM (05/24).
3) If InfoSec wants a live demo behind their firewall, we can plan an on-prem proof-of-concept — timeline depends on their environment readiness.

I'll also put Monica on thread; she'll own the scheduling and the RFI follow-up.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: redwood-private-deploy-checklist.pdf; initial-network-sketch-v0.pptx; vendor-rfi-template.xlsx)
From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: Julie Park <julie.park@novapulse.com>, James Taylor <james.taylor@novapulse.com>
Cc: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 22 May 2029 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: isolation/airgap options from today's call — scheduling & evidence notes

Julie / James — Monica here, handing scheduling and the RFI intake. A few quick clarifications before we get InfoSec the template: 

- SOC 2 status: Diego attached our current Type II report (redacted). If Novapulse needs an extended scope, we can prepare an evidence package — please indicate specific control families you care about (e.g., CC6, CC7).
- Data residency: we can pin model artifacts and storage to us-east-1. Processing can be routed to dedicated GPUs in a VPC with restricted egress.
- Air-gapped/on-prem installations: our on-prem installer is distributed as a signed bundle; customers run the installer locally. For fully air-gapped environments we provide an ops runbook and assist with a validation pass. Note that multi-tenant runtime components (if you choose hosted) will still be Redwood-managed unless you take the Private on-prem install.

Scheduling: Proposed slots for the technical deep-dive with infra architects (30–45m):
- Thu 23 May 2029, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Thu 23 May 2029, 14:00–14:45 PT
- Fri 24 May 2029, 16:00–16:45 PT

Please pick one and we'll send a calendar invite with a pre-read link (contains the checklist and sketch). If your InfoSec prefers, we can also accept the RFI in spreadsheet or via a secured Drive link.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Security & Solutions Operations
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: vendor-rfi-template.xlsx)
From: James Taylor <james.taylor@novapulse.com>

Date: Thu, 23 May 2029 11:22:00 -07:00

1) Can you highlight any known gaps between your hosted SOC 2 and what you can commit to for an on-prem installation (brief bullets)?
2) For the air-gapped option, can you confirm whether automated model updates would be manual by default and what the validation process looks like?

I'll get our InfoSec to fill the vendor-rfi-template and return by EOD Mon (05/27). Also — please upload the network sketch to the shared folder so our architects can annotate.

James Taylor
